parts.name: SelectRoot
parts.description: Holds the selected value and the open state, and shares them with the parts inside it. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders a hidden input so the value is submitted with its form.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value, or `null` for none. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the selection.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when an item is chosen.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether any number of values may be selected. The selection is then read and written through `values`, `defaultValues` and `onValuesChange`, choosing an item toggles it, and the popup stays open.

props.name: values
props.description: With `multiple`: the selected values. Pass it with `onValuesChange` to control the selection.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: With `multiple`: the values selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled.

props.name: onValuesChange
props.description: With `multiple`: called with the new list of values when an item is toggled.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the browser or a part opened or closed the popup. A press outside and Escape can't be refused: a controlled select that keeps `open` true is shown again.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the select is disabled: the trigger is a disabled button and can't open the popup. A disabled FieldRoot around it disables it too.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the popup can be opened and browsed while nothing in it can be selected.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a value must be selected for the form to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the value is submitted under. With `multiple`, each selected value is submitted as its own entry. Inside a named FieldRoot, the field's name is used.

props.name: items
props.description: The label of each value, as `{ value, label }` pairs: what SelectValue shows for a value whose item hasn't rendered yet, or whose text differs from what the trigger should say.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the options are being fetched: pass `pending? fruits` (and `fruits == null` before the first answer) for `fruits = await loadFruits()`. The popup is `aria-busy`, the parts carry `data-loading`, and `SelectValue` shows nothing for a value whose label isn't known yet, rather than the raw value. Opened before the options arrive, focus waits on the popup and moves to the selected (or first) item when they do.

parts.name: SelectTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens the popup, with `role="combobox"`. Its `popovertarget` makes the browser open and close the popup on a click, Enter and Space; ArrowDown and ArrowUp open it too, and typing on it while closed selects the matching item without opening.

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while no value is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: SelectValue
parts.description: Shows the selected item's label, the labels joined by ", " with `multiple`, or the placeholder while nothing is selected.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text shown while nothing is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while no value is selected, so the placeholder can be styled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is required.

parts.name: SelectIcon
parts.description: A decoration beside the value, such as a chevron. It is hidden from assistive technology.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true.

dataAttributes.name: data-placeholder
dataAttributes.description: Present while no value is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open, for turning the icon.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the select is required.

parts.name: SelectPopup
parts.description: The list of options, with `role="listbox"`: an element with `popover="auto"`, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning and at least as wide as it (`min-width: anchor-size(width)`). The browser closes it on Escape and on a press outside; Tab closes it too. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`. It stays in the document while closed.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger the popup sits on. The browser flips it to the other side when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the popup lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: The gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-loading
dataAttributes.description: Present while the root's `loading` is true; the popup is `aria-busy` then too.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the trigger the popup is on: the one asked for until it opens, then the one the browser placed it on.

parts.name: SelectItem
parts.description: An option in the list. A click, Enter or Space chooses it; the pointer and the arrow keys move focus to it, which highlights it.

props.name: value
props.description: The value the item stands for: what is selected, submitted and passed to `onValueChange`.

props.name: label
props.description: The text that names the value, in SelectValue and for typeahead. Without it, SelectItemText's text is used, else the item's own.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item can't be chosen. It is skipped by the arrow keys and typeahead.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has focus, from the pointer or the keyboard.

dataAttributes.name: data-label
dataAttributes.description: The item's `label` prop, when it is given.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item's value is selected.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The item's value.

parts.name: SelectItemText
parts.description: The item's text. Use it when the item holds more than its label, such as an indicator, so SelectValue and typeahead read only the text.

parts.name: SelectItemIndicator
parts.description: Shown while its item is selected, such as a check mark. It is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Whether the indicator stays rendered while its item isn't selected, for drawing an empty box that `data-selected` fills.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is selected.

parts.name: SelectGroup
parts.description: Groups related items, with `role="group"`. The group is named by its SelectGroupLabel.

parts.name: SelectGroupLabel
parts.description: The heading of a group. The group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.

parts.name: SelectSeparator
parts.description: A line between items or groups, with `role="separator"`.

parts.name: SelectArrow
parts.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
